opening.argument: The central claim is a conservative 10% monthly return through DeFi participation: “How to get 10% per month at #defi conservatively!” The video then ties that promise to a specific liquidity pool, stating that “it's just a liquidity pool that has been provided with $592” and reporting “twenty percent in 60 days.” This presents cryptocurrency-based pool participation as a way to obtain substantial, return-focused gains. The evidence does not establish any payment requirement, guaranteed outcome, completed transaction, or verified profit, but those limitations do not change the promotional investment-return claim being presented.
